resources.string: Offline SI test for a small word-form group, such as kapitalizacją / kapitalizacja or praca / pracy. SI compares at most four surfaces of two decoded words, related by Polish diacritic folding or a shared source lemma. Capitalization metadata is required to add case variants, but not to compare ordinary decoded forms. Leading suggestions show different word forms when available. Extra case alternatives remain selectable farther along the strip, including with SI off. Context comes only from the current field, preserving case and punctuation. Password, private, search, URL and email fields are excluded. FP32 used about 2.1 GiB for the whole process on the test phone; this is an experiment. Import the verified FP32 test ZIP separately. No weights or typed context are included in backups.
